title: Income Taxes—Changes in the Tax Status of an Entity or its Shareholders
summary: Addresses the income tax consequences of a change in the tax status of an entity or its shareholders, requiring the tax effect to be recognised in the same component of the financial statements as the underlying transaction or event.

related.title: Income Taxes
related.relationship: The parent standard supplying the general backward-tracing principle SIC-25 applies specifically to tax status changes

related.title: Presentation of Financial Statements
related.relationship: Governs presentation of OCI and equity components affected by SIC-25's backward-traced tax effects

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Supplies the revaluation surplus mechanics commonly implicated in SIC-25's OCI-tracing exception

related.title: Intangible Assets
related.relationship: Supplies the revaluation surplus mechanics commonly implicated in SIC-25's OCI-tracing exception
